data.name: Isle of Echoes
data.detailed_description:
Challenge authority, rewrite reality itself, and reshape the world of Aeonrealm with your law bending abilities! With your partner who calls themselves an Echo, your goal is to save Aeonrealm from itself.

Isle of Echoes is a VR Looter-Slasher with Grind Fiction themes and aesthetic. You use the abilities of your echoes to bring peace (or chaos) to the land of Aeonrealm! When Bonded wakes up in Aeonrealm, she can't remember what brought her there or her goal. Through her journey to find out, she sees the struggles of the Aeonites, hopefully she'll make the right choices.

Echoes are ancient spirits that were trapped in devices called Projectors. When a bonded has freed an echo from its projector and well...bonded with it. The echo will be grateful and offer assistance with their adventures. Each having a unique personality, design, backstory, and abilities. Which can range from controlling the direction of gravity to...gambling.

The Regions

  • amuaşima (Earth)

  • Æresbjerg (Copenhagen, Denmark) Year: 1431

  • Shìchǎng Chéngshì (Fujian, China) Year: 1807

  • Dublin (Ireland) Year: 1834

  • Gearheart (New York City, USA) Year: 1890

  • Badamjeon (Gwangju, South Korea) Year: 2003

  • D.C. (Washington, DC, USA) Year: 2036

  • Wastelands (State of Amapá, Brazil) Year: 2041

  • Badlands (Sahara Desert) Year: 2044

The Shattering was an event that brought regions from different times and places together onto a new version of Earth now referred to as "Aeonrealm," by the self-appointed leader "Aeon Park."

data.short_description: Isle of Echoes is a Grind Fiction VR Looter-Slasher with your spirit partner called an Echo. Upgrade their abilities as you go from region to region giving the power back to the people. As you get closer and closer to your goal, Aeon Park will be continuing his plan to take over the new world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated compatible with DirectX
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible HMD (Valve Index, Oculus Quest w/ Link, Vive Pro, etc.)
  • Additional Notes: Stable VR performance at lower quality settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD RX 6800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated compatible with DirectX
  • VR Support: SteamVR-compatible HMD (Valve Index, Oculus Quest w/ Link, Vive Pro, etc.)
  • Additional Notes: Required for full visual fidelity and smooth VR experience
